description: Source code for RTIO executor implementation in Zephyr OS, handling submission, execution, and completion of I/O requests.

methods.name: rtio_iodev_submit
methods.description: Submits an I/O device work request if not canceled.

methods.name: rtio_executor_op
methods.description: Handles execution of a single I/O submission based on operation type.

methods.name: rtio_executor_submit
methods.description: Processes the RTIO queue, executing pending I/O requests.

methods.name: rtio_executor_handle_multishot
methods.description: Handles logic for multishot (repeating) I/O requests, including buffer management.

methods.name: rtio_executor_done
methods.description: Finalizes an I/O request, generating completion events or cleaning up.

methods.name: rtio_executor_err
methods.description: Callback indicating I/O error or cancellation.
